title: Looking for These Character Sprite Designs

posts.author: LarvaRush
posts.body:
Hello,
I'm currently attempting to make a horror themed game. I'm not a big fan of the really small and chibi style characters that come with RPG Maker MZ. I found some that someone told me is called Looseleaf (I'll include a photo). I just wanted to know if there was a place I could find them. I found a link to a website that generates these sprites, but it has been shut down.
I'm still really green to all of this. But anything that looks similar to this would be appreciated.
